I have been farming this land for many years, and I know what works here in Mtwara. I will spread manure from our goats and chickens because store-bought fertilizer is too expensive for such a small plot, and I will plant the seed I saved from last season's harvest. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—weeding by hand when the rains come—because we have no money to hire workers, and the plot is small enough for us to manage alone.
